Final pre-freeze review of 8c1ca830: ACCEPT-WITH-NOTES, GO for freeze-then-pilot.
- Runner matches §6.
- Output byte-identical at 1 vs 4 threads.
- Atomic cell writes; resume refused on any stamp difference; dirty-tree refusal verified.
- No rate output.
- Projection is structurally sound: 1.13-1.34 core-hours measured on a 5%-scale run (~3.6 us/draw). Even at the probe's unit the pilot alone is ~4.8 h, so it will not approach the 15 h ceiling.
- R4/R7/R8 plus 3 variants are killed semantically.
- Manifest v2 2091b2d7 verified (32 hashes).
Pre-launch fixes in progress:
- L1: stamp the JDK and refuse scalafim.*.build redirects.
- L2: enforce the CPU-time ceiling at runtime and record cost.
- L3: atomic summary/stamp/selection writes.
- L5: receipt cost reconciliation (the ~7 h probe figure was pilot plus confirmation).
Then freeze the manifest.
